metadata.description: When the fire glows just right, a quiet janitor appears with stories full of mystery, mischief, and marshmallow mishaps. From talking raccoons to trails that vanish by morning, each tale blends humor, heart, and a hint of magic. With themes of bravery, friendship, and wonder, these legendary stories will spark imaginations and leave kids wondering… could it be true? Mysterious but not creepy, and perfect for cozy campfire listening!
